outcome: Fill the export program's last structural gap: dbo.account_export_job_domains, the per-domain ledger C1 created, is written by nothing. Migration PS-SETTINGS-EXPORT-010 adds one worker-only, lease-fenced atomic completion procedure, usp_CompleteAccountExportJobWithDomains, alongside C1's untouched one: it derives job and owner identity from the locked job row (never a parameter), validates the canonical 30-domain set from one JSON payload, inserts the per-domain rows, and moves the job to ready in the same transaction - both succeed or neither, with owner-active re-checked inside it. Stable per-domain schema_identifier; the job's cutoff marker as source_change_marker. All payload validation happens before Blob promote so a post-promote failure cannot strand the job. The worker calls only the new procedure and its stale reader counts are corrected. Registry entry, clean-DROP rollback, two-owner isolation verification, and the full preactivation adversarial matrix. Populating the ledger permanently blocks C1 rollback - accepted and recorded. No UI, scheduler, worker host, deployment, or production grant.
